new_events.summary: Reuters-cited Vortexa data showed September Gulf oil flows excluding Iran averaged 19.2 million bpd, about 81% of the pre-war rate. Crude and condensate flows recovered to 91% of pre-war levels while refined-fuel flows remained around 60%. Kpler data cited by Reuters showed Iran exported no crude in September.

economic_energy_updates.summary: September data showed strong non-Iranian Gulf export recovery while Iranian crude exports fell to zero; refined-product flows remained materially below pre-war levels.

material_results: September Gulf oil-flow recovery and Iran zero-crude-export snapshot
